remarks.para: Default constructor.

Note: If any child view of presentation triggers a RemoteViews#setOnClickPendingIntent(int, android.app.PendingIntent) pending intent on click, such PendingIntent must follow the restrictions below, otherwise it might not be triggered or the autofill save UI might not be shown when its activity is finished:
  • It cannot be created with the PendingIntent#FLAG_IMMUTABLE flag.
  • It must be a PendingIntent for an Activity.
  • The activity must call Activity#finish() when done.
  • The activity should not launch other activities.

remarks.para: Sets an action to be applied to the presentation template when the child view with the given id is clicked.

Typically used when the presentation uses a masked field (like ****) for sensitive fields like passwords or credit cards numbers, but offers a an icon that the user can tap to show the value for that field.

remarks.para: Updates the presentation template when a condition is satisfied by applying a series of remote view operations. This allows dynamic customization of the portion of the save UI that is controlled by the autofill service. Such dynamic customization is based on the content of target views.
The updates are applied in the sequence they are added, after the transformations are applied to the children views.
Another approach is to add a child first, then apply the transformations.
